results.description: LUSAKA (Zambia), Aug 17 (Bernama-Anadolu) -- Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema took a commanding lead Sunday in the country’s presidential race, securing more than 1.5 million votes from 135 of the 226 constituencies counted, Anadolu Ajansi (AA) reported.

results.title: Zamboanga City rolls out free EV charging stations for public use
results.description: ZAMBOANGA CITY — The city government here has installed three electric vehicle (EV) charging stations at the City Hall grounds for free public use. City Administrator Percival Ramos, who supervised the installation work, said in a statement on Thursday that two of the three EV charging stations were installed in front of the City Hall for free public use. “The other one, located inside City Hall premises, will be for use of city-owned electric vehicles,” Ramos said. results.title: H-1B visa extension fee unlikely to outweigh cost of losing skilled talent
results.description: A new US rule will extend a $4,000 H-1B fee to certain visa extensions from September 9, increasing recurring costs for employers heavily dependent on foreign workers. However, the charge may remain cheaper than replacing experienced skilled employees.
